cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Carry This with Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to share a burden by framing participation as part of the relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Take half Mum's care-home forms. Being her children can't mean I'm the paperwork child.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Then sit beside me. I'll explain, and you can write.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: All right. It asks for one main contact.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put yourself. I'll help with every answer, but Mum needs to know she can reach either of us.

mechanism: A copies an unfamiliar organizing method to appear capable, then asks B to share the burden because both belong to the relationship.
confusable: D05 recruits task help; D77 grounds shared responsibility in the relationship and can redistribute rather than dump burden.
comparison: Siblings handling care forms versus separating partners deciding what letters to keep.
seedUse: Use main-contact constraint and delayed reading as practical ways to share responsibility, not excuses for A expertise.
